title: Robust Reward Modeling via Causal Rubrics

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating reward model ranking accuracy using the reWordBench benchmark, which applies meaning-preserving transformations like adding quotes, punctuation spaces, and swapping formats, as well as qualitative analysis of model preferences for lists and markdown over raw content.

Testing model robustness against the spurious attribute of response length (word count) using counterfactual augmentations and evaluating preference accuracy on the RewardBench and reWordBench datasets.

Qualitative evaluation and comparison of reward model preferences for responses containing unnecessary polite phrases, conversational filler, or sycophantic agreement over direct, concise, and causally accurate answers.
